summary: Comprehensive SEO, crawler accessibility, and on-page optimization plan for retractscan.studio.ai. Includes robots.txt and sitemap.xml updates with zero disallow directives, optimized meta title and description under character limits, pre-rendered semantic HTML fallback in index.html to guarantee bot visibility during JS rendering checks, structured data schema suite (WebApplication, Organization, ScholarlyArticle, FAQPage), and rich on-page landing sections with high-intent H1/H2/H3 hierarchy, four-layer verification methodology, and audience breakdowns for researchers, editors, and institutions.
